explication: Worktrunk is a CLI that makes Git worktrees convenient for parallel AI-agent work. The principal flow is: a user invokes `wt`, command dispatch selects a lifecycle operation, Git repository logic creates or changes a worktree, configured hooks and optional agents run, and terminal output reports the result. The same core supports listing and interactive previews, merging and cleanup, cache copying, shell integration, CI/PR metadata, and LLM-assisted commit messages. Some integrations are represented from documented capabilities and tree paths; unsampled call details are intentionally omitted.
